# Install UI Common

## ui-common: ui-common

Choose one publishing destination and one dependency syntax.

### jitpack

Repository: **jitpack**. Confirmed version **0.1.2**. [Source commit](https://github.com/lambdawalker/android.ui.common/commit/1f85ea3752e25bca9d0df6505d86fe4ef2f8c3d1).

#### Gradle Kotlin DSL

In `settings.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
        maven { url = uri("https://jitpack.io") }
    }
}
```

In the app's `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation("com.github.lambdawalker:android.ui.common:ui-common~v0.1.2-jitpack")
}
```

#### Gradle Groovy DSL

In `settings.gradle`:

```groovy
dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
        maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
    }
}
```

In the app's `build.gradle`:

```groovy
dependencies {
    implementation 'com.github.lambdawalker:android.ui.common:ui-common~v0.1.2-jitpack'
}
```

#### Version catalog

Use the dependency repositories shown above. Add to `gradle/libs.versions.toml`:

```toml
[libraries]
ui-common = { module = "com.github.lambdawalker:android.ui.common", version = "ui-common~v0.1.2-jitpack" }
```

Then use this instead of the direct dependency in the app's `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation(libs.ui.common)
}
```

#### Maven

Add these repositories and dependency to `pom.xml`:

```xml
<repositories>
  <repository>
    <id>google</id>
    <url>https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2</url>
  </repository>
  <repository>
    <id>central</id>
    <url>https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2</url>
  </repository>
  <repository>
    <id>confirmed-2</id>
    <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
  </repository>
</repositories>
<dependencies>
  <dependency>
    <groupId>com.github.lambdawalker</groupId>
    <artifactId>android.ui.common</artifactId>
    <version>ui-common~v0.1.2-jitpack</version>
    <type>aar</type>
  </dependency>
</dependencies>
```

See the [installation guide](docs/agents/installation.md) for platform requirements and migration
from source integration. Use a destination and version confirmed above; configuration alone is not
evidence that another repository hosts the artifact.
